info.name: Nord Pool Data Portal API (Public) Auction ExchangeRate API

params.name: date
params.description: Delivery date, referring to CET date. Format yyyy-MM-dd, for example 2024-08-15

items.docs:
Returns the exchange rate used for a specific date.
            
### Nordic Day-ahead market and local currencies
For the Nordic Day-ahead market, local currency trading is allowed. At the auction day, a preliminary exchange rate is retrieved for local currencies to EUR (for example, SEK -> EUR) from a bank. This preliminary exchange rate is used to calculate order prices in EUR based on user provided input. If the user places an order with price 100 SEK and the SEK -> EUR **preliminary** exchan
